name: Reset Windows Update components (Windows)
description: Stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 to dated .bak folders, removes older .bak folders and restarts the services. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When enabled, nothing is changed and the script only prints what it would do.

output: [DRY-RUN] or [DONE]/[SKIP] lines per step. Exit 0; exit 3 if services could not be stopped. Services are restored even on failure.
